title: Coordination Chemistry of Lanthanides at "High" pH: Synthesis and Structure of the Pentadecanuclear Complex of Europium(III) with Tyrosine

material_class.structural_family: pentadecanuclear layered Eu15 barrel/wheel with encapsulated chloride

synthesis.procedure: Tyrosine (0.181 g, 1.0 mmol) was added as a solid to an aqueous solution of Eu(ClO4)3 prepared by dissolving Eu2O3 (1.408 g, 4.0 mmol) in 70% perchloric acid. One drop of 1.0 M aqueous HCl was added and the mixture was stirred at 80 °C for 5 min. The pH was then carefully adjusted by slow addition of 0.5 M aqueous NaOH until the precipitate that formed remained. The mixture was filtered and the filtrate was allowed to stand at room temperature; parallelepiped crystals appeared in about one week. The paper also states that isostructural Ln(III)–tyrosine complexes (Ln = La, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Dy) were obtained analogously by mixing Ln(ClO4)3 and tyrosine in water and adjusting the pH to about 6.
